decision_reason: Official alternatives were measured by granularity and access. DESNZ postcode gas and electricity are privacy-suppressed postcode aggregates; local-authority greenhouse-gas data is area-level; the public NEED sample is anonymised and its visible schema has no UPRN/address/postcode/property identifier; identifiable NEED requires accredited Trusted Research Environment access; EPC bulk data requires authorised access. No deterministic canonical parcel binding can be promoted.

source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: Wave321 completed with remote readback PASS and found no authorised NPS, NPS-sample, exact polygon, title-number/UPRN, EPC bulk, or token input declared for gas_emissions_2.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The 2026 anonymised NEED release provides property-level gas and electricity consumption from 2005 to 2024 in public 50,000-row and 4-million-row samples, with a separate metadata spreadsheet.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The official electricity dataset contains postcode-level domestic meter counts and total, mean, and median annual consumption. Statistics with fewer than five meters or excessive dominance by the top two meters are suppressed.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The official gas dataset contains postcode, number of meters, total annual consumption, mean consumption, and median consumption. Values are postcode aggregates, and postcodes with fewer than five meters or excessive dominance by the top two meters are suppressed.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: DESNZ states that property-level consumption data is made available to accredited researchers through Trusted Research Environments such as the Secure Research Service.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The official EPC service provides bulk certificate CSV data and a developer API for England and Wales, but bulk download requires sign-in or account creation with GOV.UK One Login.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The current accredited greenhouse-gas dataset is a breakdown by Local Authority area, derived from the national emissions inventory and local-authority energy consumption statistics; it is not parcel-level data.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The official 50,000-row NEED CSV preview exposes property characteristic, region, EPC band, measure flags, annual gas consumption, and validation fields. Indexed checks of the complete preview returned no UPRN, ADDRESS, POSTCODE, or PROP_ID token.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: Official guidance defines four routes for access to NEED property-level data and explains that components are acquired under different legislation or agreements and are not all available through every route.

ONS states the electricity-and-gas-by-property dataset is de-identified rather than fully anonymised, is held in an access-controlled protected environment, and requires successful accredited-researcher access to the Integrated Data Service.
